postData.contentHtml:
Randy Rainbow, known for his witty political parodies, has once again captured social media's attention with his latest video, 'Dummy with the Wig On Top.' This new musical number brilliantly reworks 'The Surrey with the Fringe On Top' from the beloved musical Oklahoma!, to deliver sharp-tongued criticisms of Donald Trump.

Rainbow's signature style shines through as he humorously lambasts Trump's appearance, perceived cognitive state, and declining poll numbers. Lyrics such as “Pricks and schmucks and creeps awful scummy, lickin’ boots and still gettin’ chummy, with one piece-of-shit orange dummy, with the wig on top” and “Ignore his corpselike appearance, scrambled brains and slurred incoherence, he buys votes and rugs both on clearance, and his polls kerplop!” highlight the comedian's no-holds-barred approach.

The video's release was accompanied by Rainbow's characteristic humor, as he teased his followers on social media with a playful twist on another Oklahoma! song title: 'Oh what a beautiful moron.' The parody has been met with largely positive sentiment across social media platforms, sparking lively discussion and reaffirming Rainbow's place as a leading voice in political satire.
postData.title: Randy Rainbow Skewers Trump in 'Dummy with the Wig On Top' Parody
postData.summary: Satirical sensation Randy Rainbow is back with a new musical parody, 'Dummy with the Wig On Top,' taking aim at Donald Trump using the classic tune 'The Surrey with the Fringe On Top' from *Oklahoma!*.

sources.title: Randy Rainbow Drops The Hammerstein On 'Piece Of S**t' Trump In Scathing Song Spoof
